image.alt: Cold Ham communes with a potted cactus as Fre'Do and a raven observe inside a cottage

paragraphs: 眼前的這座小鎮非常小，甚至稱呼他為小鎮都有些為過。道路一旁只有六間並排的破舊小屋，另一側則是陡峭的山壁。這六間破舊小屋甚至有一半是暗的。烏波率先走到了最近的亮的小屋，敲了敲門。一名年邁的人類老太太應了門。在確認這群陌生人看起來不危險後，便讓他們進了小屋。
屋子內不大，除了客廳外，餐桌的一側是老夫妻的臥房，另一側則是廚房與廁所。廁所內的老先生看見踏入屋內的冒險者，有些不自在的把廁所的門掩上。

老太太和冒險者們說明這座沒有名字的小鎮上沒有像酒館那樣的地方，除了他們一戶老夫妻外，剩下兩戶各四口人家，也就三個家庭十個人而已。他們的孩子也已成年，到大城市去自力更生了。冒險者們詢問老太太是否有遭遇狼人的襲擊，但很顯然，老太太對於「狼人」是什麼都不太清楚，不過，他提到隔壁間的房子昨晚有遭到「怪物」攻擊，他的老公和其他幾戶人家有一起去幫忙確認狀況，將現場簡單收拾。聽聞此事，冷火腿和弗雷多決定到隔壁屋子去看看。巴斯低調地對著弗雷多用妖精語，請他藉這個機會觀察一下這位新來的夥伴有什麼意圖？是否可靠？烏波讓他的烏鴉也跟著到另一間屋子去，巴斯與烏波兩人則先待在老夫妻的房子內。
餐桌上，烏波拿出前一晚燻乾的狼人肉，想分一點給老太太吃，但老太太似乎對這類香料的味道不太喜愛，便喊著要去廚房幫他們準備點吃的，落荒而逃。反之，聞到了燻肉的香氣，老先生推開了廁所門，徑直走向餐桌，和烏波要了一塊肉來吃，十分滿足。

未點燈的屋內，冷火腿、弗雷多與烏波的烏鴉並未看見任何破壞與打鬥的痕跡。冷火腿點了火，讓他能看得更清楚。臥室的地板上留有一些尚未清理乾淨的血跡，但也僅此而已。期間，弗雷多也和冷火腿攀談，打聽他跟著冒險者們一起行動的契機與他的故事。冷火腿表示要前往自己的目的地，途中會經過冒險者們要去的石原鎮，而他也深知獨自在外冒險的危險，因此有機會結伴同行，對他來說不是壞事。對於狼人，他了解的也有限，頂多比冒險者們多一點點而已。

弗雷多在房子的另一側找到了一株觀賞用的小仙人掌盆栽。冷火腿利用自己的能力，和仙人掌詢問了前一晚在這裡看見的景象。透過仙人掌，他得知這一家人有三口。前一晚，先生突然從人類變形為狼人，兇狠地將他的妻子殺害，甚至啃食了部分，但他的行為不至於失控，更像是在他的控制之下做了這些舉動，冷靜而讓人不寒而慄。而在這之後，化為狼人的先生帶著熟睡的孩子推開門離開了。瀕死前妻子的尖叫聲，並未阻止先生的暴行，在先生帶著孩子離開後，隔壁屋子的老先生帶了根棍棒來到了現場，也才發現了被兇狠殺害的太太。
冷火腿將他得知的資訊轉達給烏鴉以及弗雷多，也決定將這株仙人掌帶在身上，如此輕便，不是什麼問題。烏鴉聽完後，便飛回老夫妻的房子，將消息轉達給烏波。

同一時間，烏波將肉乾剪碎，倒在自己帶的石缽內，繼續給老先生吃。老先生越吃越開心，起身往廚房去，想拿些酒分給烏波和巴斯。廚房內飄出香氣，巴斯看見老太太似乎在炒菜。老先生彎腰，從廚房的櫃子內搬出一大罐沒有標籤的酒，沒意外大概是私釀的酒吧。走回餐桌，他兀自將酒倒入了烏波的石缽內，烏波趕緊阻止，但肉乾已經被浸泡在濃濃的私釀酒內了。在烏波的解釋下，老先生又跑回廚房內拿了幾個小酒杯，將酒倒給烏波和他。巴斯拒絕了倒酒的邀請，甚至裝作自己不懂通用語，用著妖精語胡亂地回答。
很快的，老先生就醉倒了。烏波趁機偷偷檢查老先生的背上，是否有出現在前一隻狼人身上看見的可疑圖騰：一對尖銳的利牙，但沒有找到。看著老太太還在廚房忙碌，巴斯偷偷潛入了老夫妻的臥室，將門關上。不過，除了珠寶盒內漂亮的珍珠項鍊外，並沒有任何讓他感到可疑的東西。
老太太將炒菜端上餐桌，邀請烏波吃著配酒，也詢問他是否還有需要任何其他的餐點。最終在老太太的推薦下，烏波同意了吃點臘肉。
回到餐桌的巴斯和烏波說了自己在房內沒注意到任何可疑的東西，判斷這對老夫妻大概不是狼人。對他們的警戒，轉為擔心今晚他們的安危。此時，冷火腿與弗雷多已回到房前。他們加入了其他人的餐桌，吃著老太太炒的菜。不久後老太太端上了臘肉，好客的他甚至拿了不少麵包給冒險者們，怕他們肚子餓。巴斯將醉倒的老先生抱到臥室內休息。

詢問老太太後，冒險者們得知平常每個月都會有一批商隊將物資帶來這裡。前幾天正好有一批進貨，否則這裡似乎也不像農作物長得起來的地方。其中，隔壁間的男主人，也就是冷火腿與弗雷多聽見仙人掌說的話為狼人的男人，平常是跟著商隊行動的商人，這次決定留下來一段時間，陪陪家人也休息休息，待商隊這趟旅程折返後，預計再次加入。沒想到卻發生了這樣的慘劇。冒險這們也好奇這麼小的房子，除了老夫妻外，當時他們的孩子是怎麼一起生活的？老太太說明以前他們夫妻一人陪孩子在臥房睡，另一人則在客廳的沙發上休息。如此困苦的生活環境，讓冒險者們不太理解為何他們願意繼續待在這裡，但基於禮貌，他們沒有和老太太詢問。
餐後，冒險者們決定在隔壁屋子，也就是前一晚案發的房子內過夜。老太太主動提出可以借他們前一晚老先生用的棍棒，讓他們防身，但冒險者們禮貌地婉謝了。
來到案發的屋子，烏波在桌前爬上了椅子，癱軟地睡去了。冷火腿則在客廳找了舒服的位子休息。巴斯與弗雷多來到臥室內討論今晚該如何守夜。弗雷多猶豫著是否該去老夫妻的房前站崗，但最終他們同意先守好自己這間屋子就好。老太太在他們離開前也承諾了，如果發生狀況，會尖叫請求他們幫忙。
日出後，巴斯與弗雷多都已清醒。弗雷多趕緊跑到老夫妻的房前確認他們的安危。震耳欲聾的打呼聲讓他安心了不少，但他還是敲了敲門。穿著睡衣的老太太微笑的應門，告訴他兩人都安全，也確保了冒險者們安然度過了作夜。
冒險者們都清醒後，簡單整頓，便繼續朝著石原鎮的方向前進了。依照弗雷多的估算，距離石原鎮，還有三、四天的路程。
連續兩天，如弗雷多所述，路上都沒有任何城鎮。商隊留下的馬蹄印依然清晰，往這條路走似乎是正確的。
弗雷多私下和巴斯提到，大概再一天左右的路程，會經過一座月神芬尼爾的教堂。他知道巴斯對芬尼爾不太喜愛，但他也提出如果要繞路，可能會拖延時間。對於想早點到石原鎮的巴斯來說，怎麼做決定好像都不太對。弗雷多提議，快到教堂時，他可以先去探探狀況，如果沒有太多人的話，一樣可以簡單經過就好。
然而，靈敏的烏波早就嗅到了芬尼爾的味。他率先往前跑，看見了地平線的另一端冒出兩名身穿芬尼爾教袍的人形生物。烏波熱情地打了招呼，兩人也熱絡地回應他。這兩人似乎一位是人類，另一位則是妖精。攀談後，兩名芬尼爾的僧侶決定先在路邊的大石頭旁休息，也分享他們的午餐給烏波和他的夥伴們。

隨著冒險者們走進，兩名僧侶發現這些人似乎不是全都是芬尼爾的信徒，尤其以綠色衣服為主要打扮的弗雷多，怎麼看都有種⋯⋯涅西斯信徒的味。兩人和冒險者們分享到，他們是從前面一座芬尼爾教堂來的，預計要往斐納札去。聽到熟悉的地名，烏波便開心地分享自己是斐納札的「心空席」。聽見這個稱號，兩名僧侶馬上恭敬地和他致意，並把隨身攜帶的各種美食遞出，分享給烏波和其他冒險者們。巴斯見狀，先把看起來比較美味的食物吃了一遍，接著十分蓄意的糟蹋剩下的食物，另兩名僧侶面有難色。期間，冒險者們也和僧侶談到了近期看見的芬尼爾信徒，包含較為激進的月光狩獵會。對此，那名妖精僧侶的反應，讓冒險者們覺得他也有可能是月光狩獵會的支持者。不久後，兩名僧侶上路，冒險者們簡單休息後便繼續朝著石原鎮的方向走去。距離石圓鎮，還有兩天的路程。
遠處，一座山丘聳立。山丘上一座小小的建築，烏波一看就知道那是芬尼爾的教堂，便飛奔而去，弗雷多也急忙趕上。這時已近傍晚，距離石原鎮大約剩下一天的路程。山丘外，附近並沒有其他的城鎮。
烏波急切地敲了敲教堂的門，冷火腿則感知到這附近的範圍內，教堂內有個個體⋯⋯很有可能是狼人。除此之外，沒有其他的生命。他擠到了門前，要大家小心。
烏波推開了門，眼前是一片屍海，至少在落日的光下，能瞥見的就有四五具人類的屍體，在小小的教堂內，已經把地板擠得滿滿的。冷火腿也感應到了在教堂內左側，那頭狼人還在啃食著。

烏波要大家後退。眼看芬尼爾的信徒們被如此兇殘的殺害，他想把這座已經被玷污的教堂毀了以洩憤。既然正門是教堂唯一的出入口，那堵在門前，那名狼人就無處可逃了吧。烏波的身體逐漸變大，直到與教堂差不多高，接著他用力地對著建物敲擊，試圖破壞它。巴斯掏出火炬並點燃它，朝著門內丟了進去。火勢在教堂內逐漸延燒。「啪！」的一聲，屋內的怪物似乎決定從後方的玻璃窗外竄逃。注意到這件事，烏波趕緊繞到了教堂後方，巴斯與冷火腿也趕緊跟上，弗雷多則小心翼翼地保持些距離。
繞過轉角，烏波沒看見任何身影，但在繞到教堂後側時，他感覺到了胸口深深的爪痕。眼前的，是一頭受了傷，眼神卻依然充滿殺意的狼人。

The settlement before them was tiny—calling it a town was almost an exaggeration. Just six dilapidated cottages stood in a row along one side of the road, with a steep mountainside on the other. Half of the cottages were dark. Ubbo approached the nearest lit house and knocked. An elderly human woman answered. Once she had decided that the strangers did not look dangerous, she let them inside.

The house was small. Beyond the sitting room, the elderly couple's bedroom lay on one side of the dining table, with the kitchen and toilet on the other. Seeing the adventurers enter, the old man in the toilet awkwardly pulled the door shut.

The old woman explained that this nameless settlement had nothing like a tavern. Besides the two of them, there were only two other households of four: three families and ten people altogether. Their own children had grown up and moved to the big cities to make lives for themselves. The adventurers asked whether she had encountered any werewolf attacks. She clearly had little idea what a “werewolf” was, but mentioned that the house next door had been attacked by a “monster” the previous night. Her husband and people from the other households had gone over to check and tidy up the scene. Hearing this, Cold Ham and Fre'Do decided to investigate. Buzz quietly spoke to Fre'Do in Elvish, asking him to use the opportunity to learn what their new companion wanted and whether he could be trusted. Ubbo sent his raven along, while he and Buzz stayed with the elderly couple.

At the table, Ubbo took out the werewolf meat he had smoked the night before and offered some to the old woman. She seemed to dislike the smell of its seasoning, however, and fled to the kitchen, declaring that she would prepare something for them to eat. Her husband had the opposite reaction: drawn by the aroma of smoked meat, he opened the toilet door, went straight to the table, and asked Ubbo for a piece, which he ate with great satisfaction.

Inside the unlit house, Cold Ham, Fre'Do, and Ubbo's raven found no signs of damage or a struggle. Cold Ham lit a fire to see more clearly. A few bloodstains that had not been fully cleaned away remained on the bedroom floor, but that was all. Meanwhile, Fre'Do chatted with Cold Ham, asking about his story and what had brought him to travel with the party. Cold Ham explained that the route to his destination would take him through Stonefield, where the adventurers were headed. He knew all too well the dangers of traveling alone, so having companions seemed a good thing. His knowledge of werewolves was limited, only a little greater than theirs.

On the other side of the house, Fre'Do found a small ornamental cactus in a pot. Cold Ham used his abilities to ask it what it had witnessed the previous night. From the cactus, he learned that a family of three had lived here. The night before, the husband had suddenly transformed from a human into a werewolf, savagely killed his wife, and even eaten part of her. Yet he had not seemed out of control. His actions appeared deliberate, carried out with a chilling calm. Afterward, the werewolf had picked up his sleeping child, opened the door, and left. His dying wife's screams had done nothing to stop him. Only after he had taken the child away did the old man from next door arrive with a club and discover the brutally murdered woman.

Cold Ham relayed what he had learned to the raven and Fre'Do. He also decided to take the cactus with him; it was light enough to carry without trouble. After hearing the account, the raven flew back to the elderly couple's house to tell Ubbo.

Meanwhile, Ubbo cut the dried meat into small pieces, tipped them into the stone bowl he carried, and continued feeding the old man. Growing happier with every bite, the man went to the kitchen to fetch some liquor for Ubbo and Buzz. Delicious smells drifted from the kitchen, where Buzz could see the old woman stir-frying a dish. Her husband bent down and pulled a large, unlabeled jar from a cupboard—probably homemade liquor. Back at the table, he promptly poured it into Ubbo's stone bowl. Ubbo tried to stop him, but the meat was already soaking in the strong liquor. Once Ubbo explained, the old man returned to the kitchen for small cups and poured drinks for himself and Ubbo. Buzz refused a drink, even pretending not to understand Common and replying with nonsense in Elvish.

The old man soon passed out drunk. Ubbo took the opportunity to inspect his back for the suspicious emblem they had seen on the earlier werewolf: a pair of sharp fangs. He found nothing. With the old woman still busy in the kitchen, Buzz slipped into the couple's bedroom and shut the door. Apart from a beautiful pearl necklace in a jewelry box, however, he found nothing suspicious.

The old woman brought her stir-fried dish to the table and invited Ubbo to eat it with his drink, asking whether he wanted anything else. On her recommendation, he eventually agreed to have some cured pork.

Returning to the table, Buzz told Ubbo that he had found nothing suspicious in the bedroom. They concluded that the elderly couple were probably not werewolves, and their wariness turned into concern for the couple's safety that night. Cold Ham and Fre'Do had meanwhile returned to the house. They joined the others at the table and ate the old woman's cooking. Before long, she brought out the cured pork. Ever hospitable, she also gave the adventurers plenty of bread, worried that they might still be hungry. Buzz carried the unconscious old man into the bedroom to rest.

In answer to their questions, the old woman explained that a caravan usually brought supplies once a month. A delivery had arrived just a few days ago; the surrounding land certainly did not look suitable for growing crops. The husband next door—the man the cactus had identified as a werewolf—was a merchant who normally traveled with the caravan. This time, he had decided to stay home for a while to rest and spend time with his family, planning to rejoin the caravan on its return journey. Instead, this tragedy had occurred. The adventurers also wondered how the couple and their children had once managed in such a small house. The woman explained that one parent would sleep with the children in the bedroom, while the other slept on the sitting-room sofa. The adventurers could not quite understand why anyone would choose to remain in such difficult conditions, but politeness kept them from asking.

After dinner, the adventurers decided to spend the night next door, in the house where the attack had occurred. The old woman offered to lend them the club her husband had used the previous night so that they could defend themselves, but they politely declined.

At the house, Ubbo climbed onto a chair at the table and slumped into sleep. Cold Ham found a comfortable spot in the sitting room to rest. Buzz and Fre'Do went into the bedroom to discuss the night's watch. Fre'Do considered standing guard outside the elderly couple's house, but they eventually agreed to focus on protecting their own lodging. Before they left, the old woman had promised to scream for their help if anything happened.

After sunrise, Buzz and Fre'Do were both awake. Fre'Do hurried to the elderly couple's door to check on them. Thunderous snoring reassured him, but he knocked anyway. The old woman answered with a smile, still in her nightclothes. She told him that they were both safe and made sure that the adventurers had also come through the night unharmed.
Once everyone was awake, the adventurers made a few simple preparations and resumed their journey toward Stonefield. By Fre'Do's estimate, they still had three or four days of travel ahead.
For two days, just as Fre'Do had said, they passed no towns at all. The hoofprints left by the caravan were still clear, suggesting that they were on the right road.

Fre'Do privately told Buzz that in about another day's travel they would pass a chapel dedicated to Phyneal, the moon god. He knew that Buzz disliked Phyneal, but warned that going around it could delay them. For Buzz, who wanted to reach Stonefield quickly, neither choice felt right. Fre'Do suggested that he could scout ahead when they drew close. If there were not many people there, they could simply pass by as planned.

Ubbo's keen senses, however, had already picked up the scent of Phyneal. He ran ahead and saw two humanoids in Phyneal's religious robes appear on the horizon. He greeted them enthusiastically, and they responded just as warmly. One seemed to be human and the other an elf. After chatting, the two monks decided to rest beside a large roadside boulder and share their lunch with Ubbo and his companions.

As the other adventurers approached, the monks realized that not everyone in the group seemed to follow Phyneal. Fre'Do, in particular, dressed mostly in green, had a distinct air of... a follower of Nessis. The monks explained that they had come from a chapel of Phyneal farther ahead and were bound for Fenadra. Delighted to hear a familiar place mentioned, Ubbo announced that he was Fenadra's “Heartless Seat.” At the title, both monks immediately paid their respects and offered all kinds of food from their packs to him and his companions. Buzz first ate whatever looked tastiest, then quite deliberately wasted the remaining food, leaving the monks visibly uncomfortable. During the meal, the adventurers also discussed followers of Phyneal they had encountered recently, including the more radical Moonlight Hunting Club. The elven monk's reaction made them suspect that he, too, might support the group. The monks soon departed. After a brief rest, the adventurers continued toward Stonefield, still two days away.

A hill rose in the distance, with a small building standing on top. Ubbo recognized it at once as a chapel of Phyneal and dashed toward it, with Fre'Do hurrying after him. It was already approaching evening, and Stonefield was about a day's journey away. There were no other settlements near the hill.

Ubbo eagerly knocked on the chapel door. Cold Ham, meanwhile, sensed a presence inside the building—very likely a werewolf. He could detect no other life in the surrounding area. He squeezed his way to the door and warned everyone to be careful.

Ubbo pushed the door open to a sea of bodies. In the fading sunlight alone, he could make out four or five human corpses, enough to crowd the floor of the little chapel. Cold Ham also sensed the werewolf on the left-hand side of the building, still feeding.

Ubbo told everyone to stand back. Seeing Phyneal's followers slaughtered so savagely, he wanted to destroy the desecrated chapel to vent his anger. If the front door was the building's only entrance and exit, surely blocking it would leave the werewolf nowhere to run. Ubbo grew until he was nearly as tall as the chapel, then struck the building hard, trying to tear it down. Buzz lit a torch and threw it through the doorway. Flames gradually spread inside. With a crash, the monster apparently chose to escape through a rear window. Realizing what had happened, Ubbo hurried around the chapel, with Buzz and Cold Ham close behind. Fre'Do cautiously kept his distance.
